column1: # Game images for the picture tests of the TaylorMade interpreter
# id      names the row and its golden, expected/<id>.txt. A row with the id
#         "-" is a companion: a file the game needs next to it that is not
# dir     folder under games/ the file lives in. Files that share a folder
#         belong to one game and find each other by file name, so the names
# keys    keys typed at the prompts before the first command line:
#         n answers "load a saved game?", 1/2/3 pick the version on a C64
#         Temple of Terror image, a leading y/n answers "combine the two
#         sides?" of the Spectrum one. Empty when the game does not ask
# note    game as detected; container variant
